content_data.meeting_title: Strategic Review: Renewable Energy Portfolio Expansion and Grid Integration
agenda_items: Strategic alignment on battery storage capacity expansion timeline
Assess hydrogen infrastructure investment opportunities and partnership frameworks
Discuss regulatory compliance updates for carbon neutrality commitments
Evaluate grid modernization requirements for renewable integration in emerging markets
key_decisions: Greenlit partnership with three regional utilities for hydrogen production and distribution network
Approved $2.8B capital allocation for offshore wind projects in Southeast Asian markets over 18 months
action_items: Head of Renewable Assets to prepare detailed implementation roadmap for offshore wind projects within 60 days
Chief Strategy Officer to finalize partnership terms with utility companies and present framework within 45 days
Chief Sustainability Officer to update board on carbon reduction pathway alignment at next governance meeting
VP of Operations to commission third-party assessment of grid infrastructure readiness by end of next quarter
